t0009-01.gloss: A correction is hidden while its headline remains easy to read.
t0009-01.rival_reading: An office could fold an old correction out of view while updating unrelated public material; a torn column does not establish a cover-up.

t0009-02.gloss: A sprayer and crop sketch carry the same green trace.
t0009-02.rival_reading: An emergency cleanup could place ordinary gardening equipment beside a route sketch; residue and a drawing do not prove a program was involved.
